Build a dense scan-by-m/z matrix from an experiment's MS data

build_ms_matrix.Rd

Build a dense scan-by-m/z matrix from an experiment's MS data

Usage

build_ms_matrix(
  ms,
  rt_range = NULL,
  mz_min = .get_moosaic_option("mz_min"),
  mz_max = .get_moosaic_option("mz_max"),
  mz_bin = .get_moosaic_option("mz_bin")
)

Arguments

ms

The ms slot of a gcms_fid_exp, or a gcms_fid_exp object.

rt_range

Optional numeric length-2 vector (min); inclusive subset of scans.

mz_min, mz_max, mz_bin

Numeric; default to the moosaic.mz_min, moosaic.mz_max and moosaic.mz_bin options.

Value

A list with D (dense numeric matrix, scans x m/z bins), rt (scan times) and mz (bin-centre m/z values).

Details

Fractional m/z values are assigned to the nearest bin centre and intensities within a bin are summed.

Examples

ms <- list(
  data = cbind(
    rt = c(1, 1, 2),
    mz = c(40.1, 41.2, 40.2),
    intensity = c(10, 5, 8)
  ),
  rt = c(1, 2)
)
build_ms_matrix(ms, mz_min = 40, mz_max = 41, mz_bin = 1)
#> $D
#>      40 41
#> [1,] 10  5
#> [2,]  8  0
#> 
#> $rt
#> [1] 1 2
#> 
#> $mz
#> [1] 40 41
#>
